products.title: Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH LED Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH is a 27-inch 4K UHD LED monitor designed for detailed visuals and multitasking. It features a 3840 x 2160 resolution IPS panel with 350 cd/m² brightness, a 1000:1 static contrast ratio, and HDR10 support for enhanced color and contrast. The monitor includes versatile connectivity with USB-C (providing 90W charging and data transfer), LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort. It is equipped with a built-in KVM switch and supports Picture-in-Picture/Picture-by-Picture. For user comfort, it features an ergonomic stand supporting tilt, swivel, and height adjustment, along with Eye Saver Mode and Flicker Free technology.

products.title: Viewfinity S8 Monitor
products.description: This Samsung ViewFinity S8 monitor boasts a 27-inch IPS display with a 4K UHD resolution, offering crisp visuals and vibrant colors with 1.07 billion color support and 99% sRGB color gamut. The anti-glare, flicker-free screen ensures comfortable viewing, even during extended use. With a 60Hz refresh rate and 5ms response time, it's suitable for various tasks, from professional work to casual entertainment. The monitor features a versatile stand with tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, and a VESA mount for flexible placement. Connectivity options include HDMI, DisplayPort, and multiple USB ports, along with an RJ45 Ethernet port.

products.title: Samsung 27" ViewFinity S8 (S80HF) 5K UHD High Resolution Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80HF is a 27-inch 5K HDR monitor designed for productivity and high-detail work. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with a native resolution of 5120 x 2880, offering 77% more pixels than 4K for exceptional clarity. The monitor supports HDR10 for true-to-life colors and a wide color gamut. Connectivity is comprehensive, featuring USB-C with 90W power delivery, LAN port for Ethernet, HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4. It includes a built-in KVM switch for controlling two sources with one keyboard and mouse, as well as Picture-in-Picture (PIP) and Picture-by-Picture (PBP) functionality. An adjustable ergonomic stand allows for tilting, swiveling, height adjustment, and 90-degree pivoting. For eye comfort, it includes TÜV-certified Eye Saver Mode and flicker-free technology.

products.title: ViewFinity S8 (S80UD) 37" 4K UHD LED Monitor
products.description: Experience crystal-clear visual excellence with the Samsung 37" ViewFinity S8 Monitor. Featuring 4K UHD resolution for enhanced detail and a larger screen space, this monitor is ideal for professionals working on intricate designs, complex diagrams, or dynamic video content.
